product: Raffia Slide Sandal — Chunky Block Heel, Square Open Toe, Metal Chain Mule
reference_style: Tory Burch luxury e-commerce product photography
source_images: Use the existing TikTok product photos for each color as the input image

photography_system.style_notes: Tory Burch uses 4 shots per colorway: (1) three-quarter angle hero, (2) side profile silhouette, (3) extreme detail close-up on hardware/texture, (4) overhead flat lay. All on pure white seamless backgrounds, soft diffused studio lighting, minimal shadows, elevated minimalist aesthetic.

angle.source_image: Use the beige colorway main product photo (three-quarter view)
angle.prompt: Restyle this raffia slide sandal as a luxury e-commerce product photograph in the style of Tory Burch. Place the sandal at a three-quarter front-left angle, slightly elevated and tilted to show both the top woven raffia texture and the side profile simultaneously. Pure white seamless infinity background with no edges or seams visible. Soft diffused overhead studio lighting from slightly above and to the left, creating even illumination with no harsh shadows. Very subtle soft contact shadow directly beneath the sole. The gold chain buckle hardware should catch a gentle specular highlight. Crisp focus across the entire product. Clean, bright, airy exposure. High-end minimalist luxury aesthetic. No text, no branding, no watermarks. Single sandal only. 1:1 square format.

side.source_image: Use the beige colorway side/profile product photo

Pure white seamless background. Soft diffused studio lighting from above, even illumination, no harsh shadows. The woven raffia texture is gently visible in the light. detail.source_image: Use the beige colorway photo showing the chain hardware up close
detail.prompt: Restyle this as a luxury e-commerce detail close-up in the style of Tory Burch. The gold chain links and interlocking buckle should fill approximately 60% of the frame. The handwoven raffia pattern is clearly visible behind and around the hardware. Soft diffused studio lighting with gentle specular highlights on the polished gold. Slight shallow depth of field — chain sharp, background raffia slightly softer. Pure white background. Clean, luxurious lighting showing material quality and craftsmanship. No text, no branding. 1:1 square format.
